basic_details.short_information: Central Recruitment Cell, Gauhati High Court Kohima Bench on behalf of the Nagaland District Court has notified 8 vacancies including 1 post of Driver. The pay for the Driver post is Level-3(18000-56900), and the required qualification is HSLC pass with valid professional driving license to drive LMV/Four wheel vehicle for not less than 5 years. Eligible candidates can submit their online application from 17 October 2026 to 6 November 2026, with the last date for payment of fees on 6 November 2026. Register by providing primary credentials such as Username, Password, Email, Date of Birth, and Mobile Number, and note down the Registration Code.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of three stages: Stage-I Screening test (written examination), Stage-II Driving test, and Stage-III Interview/Viva-Voce. Stage-I Screening test (40 marks): Objective Type Multiple Choices on OMR sheet of 1 hour duration containing Road Sign recognition (20 marks) and General Knowledge (20 marks). Marks obtained in the written examination will not be counted while preparing the final merit list. Candidates equal to 5 times the number of vacancies (1:5) in order of merit in the screening test will be called for the driving test. Stage-II Driving test (40 marks): Conducted on segments viz. starting, driving, parking, and after driving (10 marks for each segment). Candidates must secure at least 50% marks (20 out of 40) to qualify. Candidates equal to 3 times the number of vacancies (1:3) in order of merit in the driving test will be called for the interview. Stage-III Interview/Viva-Voce (20 marks): Includes viva-voce and document verification. Candidates must secure at least 60% marks (12 out of 20) to qualify. Final selection is based on the total marks obtained in the driving test and interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Nagaland District Court Driver
content_sections.text: Log on through the website Official Website and click on Online Application for the posts of Driver in District Courts of Nagaland under Kohima Bench of the Gauhati High Court. Register by providing primary credentials such as Username, Password, Email, Date of Birth, and Mobile Number, and note down the Registration Code. Login using the registered email and password, go through instructions, and fill in Personal, Qualification, and Additional Information in the application form. Upload recent passport photo and signature in .jpg format (5kb – 150kb) with clear white backgrounds. Upload academic documents (10th Standard Admit Card & Marksheet) and caste/indigenous certificates in single clear pdf files (40kb – 4MB). Make the application fee payment of Rs. 300 by scanning the QR code or transferring to the bank account, then enter the Transaction ID and upload the payment receipt. Submit the completed application form and retain a confirmation for reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Nagaland District Court Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online application is 6 November 2026 till office hours, and the last date for fee payment is 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for the Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed HSLC and hold a valid professional driving license to drive LMV or four-wheel vehicles for not less than the last 5 years.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit and relaxation for ST candidates?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 32 years as on the last date of receipt of application, with a 5-year relaxation for Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates up to an upper age limit of 37 years.

faq.question: Q4. Will the written examination marks be counted in the final merit list?
faq.answer: No, marks obtained in the Stage-I written screening test will not be counted while preparing the final merit list.
